Landing.metaTitle: Estudia — Less chaos, more time to learn
Landing.metaDescription: Organize subjects, tasks, exams and study hours in one place. Free and ad-free.
Landing.eyebrow: Your whole term, in one place
Landing.description: Organize subjects, tasks, exams and study time without juggling different tools. Estudia shows you what comes next and how you are progressing.
Landing.featuresDescription: The essential tools to plan your term, focus on what matters and understand your progress.
Landing.tasksText: Organize work by status and priority, add deadlines and always focus on the next step.
Landing.agendaText: Bring classes, study sessions, deadlines and exams together so important dates never catch you off guard.
Landing.timeText: Log the hours spent on each task and see where you are really investing your effort.
Landing.gradesText: Calculate weighted averages and review every subject’s performance without spreadsheets.
Landing.stepsTitle: Organize your term in three steps
Landing.stepOneText: Build your academic space with the courses you are taking this term or semester.
Landing.stepTwoText: Add tasks, exams and events with their dates, priorities and key details.
Landing.stepThreeText: Log your time, complete tasks and review your progress from one clear dashboard.
Landing.ctaTitle: Your term can feel much lighter
Landing.ctaText: Create your Estudia space and bring order to everything ahead of you.

Terms.title: Terms of use
Terms.intro: Estudia is a personal, free, ad-free project for organizing your studies. These terms explain the basic rules for using the service.
Terms.acceptanceText: By creating an account and using Estudia, you accept these terms. If you don't agree, please don't use the service.
Terms.serviceText: Estudia is a personal, free tool for organizing subjects, tasks, exams, grades, and study time. It's an independent project with no affiliation to any educational institution.
Terms.accountText: You're responsible for keeping your password secret and for all activity on your account. The information you provide (name, email) must be accurate.
Terms.acceptableUseText: You may not use Estudia to upload illegal content, attempt to access other people's accounts, or deliberately overload the service (for example, with bots or automated scraping).
Terms.contentText: The academic data you enter (tasks, grades, exams...) is yours. It's only used to provide you the service, as detailed in the privacy policy.
Terms.availabilityText: Estudia is a personal project maintained outside working hours. It's provided "as is", without any guarantee of continuous availability or freedom from errors.
Terms.liabilityText: To the extent permitted by law, Estudia is not liable for data loss, service interruptions, or indirect damages arising from its use. We recommend not relying on Estudia as the sole copy of important information.
Terms.suspensionText: An account that breaches these terms may be suspended or removed. You can delete your account at any time from your profile or by contacting us.
Terms.changesText: These terms may be updated. Relevant changes will be reflected with a new "last updated" date.
Terms.lawText: These terms are governed by Spanish law.
Terms.contactText: For any questions about these terms, contact us:

Privacy.title: Privacy
Privacy.intro: Estudia is a personal, free and ad-free project for organizing studies.
Privacy.controllerText: Jordi Pujol is responsible for Estudia. For privacy questions or to request deletion of data, use the form:
Privacy.dataText: Estudia stores your name, email, protected credential, optional photo, academic data you enter, and technical session and security information. If you contact Estudia, your email, subject and message are also processed.
Privacy.useText: This information is used only to provide and protect the service or respond to your enquiry. It is kept while the account is active or for as long as needed to handle the message, and is not sold or used for advertising.
Privacy.infrastructureText: Estudia uses hosting, storage, database, security and email delivery providers that process information only to provide the necessary infrastructure.
Privacy.cookiesText: Two technical cookies are used: one to keep you signed in for up to 7 days and another to remember the language until you close the browser. There are no analytics or advertising cookies, so no consent banner is needed.
Privacy.analyticsText: Vercel Analytics is used to measure visits anonymously and in aggregate. It does not use cookies or create individual profiles; it only helps understand which pages are visited most.
Privacy.rightsText: You can request access, correction, export or deletion of your data through the contact form.
Privacy.complaintBefore: If you believe your data has not been handled correctly, you may submit a complaint to the
Privacy.ageText: Estudia is intended for people aged 14 or over.
